title: One filtered population
brief: Reuse one filtered population for consistent summaries.
instructions: Return one row containing paid UTC 2024 order count and distinct customer count. Base both summaries on the same population.
For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,customer_id,status,ordered_at from orders without solving one filtered population.

hints.text: A named relation makes one population reusable.
Define qualifying orders once and query that relation for both counts.
Nine qualifying orders belong to only two customers in the boundary.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT count(*)::VARCHAR || '/' || count(DISTINCT customer_id)::VARCHAR FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: nine qualifying orders belong to two customers
